lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When did you see it, when you first went out there or when?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So, let's just go through you, what time did you go out there?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. So at 9:00 you go out and you go right by the fire?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK, and you see what exactly, explain to me exactly what you saw at 9:00.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Branches, tires, tires, like a garbage bag, and....................

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So you went there at 9:00, you see the branches, the tires, the garbage, it's all on the fire already? Is it burning already?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then you go get the car seat?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And how do you get that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: We put it in the back of the golf cart.
